shortfall_reason: Four of ten, deliberately. 162 candidates, 27 carry a valid bracket (16.7%) — the other 135 have bracket.valid false and therefore no stateable loss boundary, which is a C2 failure before any signal is read. Of those 27, only 7 pass R3 on the nameable first exit (bracket.rr_tp1 >= the R-cost of a one-ATR gap through bracket.stop); the passing set's median bracket.rr_tp1 is 0.96R against gapped losses of 1.6-2.0R, i.e. most of today's brackets do not pay for one bad overnight at the first exit. Three of the seven survivors (MDB, HNGE, EVC) were dropped at step 2 because sc_m_gate_detail read 0/5, 0/5 and 1/5 — a composite with no confirming component is a fitted number with no stated reason it exists (C12). C21: filing four on a day that offered four is the output of a working method, not a shortfall. No name exceeds conviction 3 because the packet carries no base rate, no loser count and no cost-net figure — C13/C15 are unmet across the entire board, and a 4 or 5 would be unearned.
